lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

value.command: On an isolated Debug emulator run MapRuntimeDiagnosticsNativeTest via DiagnosticsTestRunner with an explicit synthetic DSN.
steps: Block the main looper with a synthetic query and verify the observer persists a bounded snapshot before the main thread returns and BeforeSend includes it.
Saturate the real local tile server with two blocked workers and sixteen queued requests; verify the next request returns 503 with queue_full and a request id.
Run ProjectSyncRunnerTest and the unit parsing/commit-failure fixtures; retain the original pending queue and check the precise phase/cause.
value.expected: Fast operations do not write, slow/failed operations remain observable with bounded overhead, HTTP reasons survive SDK context and sync failure never clears recovery state.
